s001.gmc.graph.modeling.with.live: GMC graph modeling with live diagrams, plus a Notion-like WYSIWYG Markdown editor: rich diffs, tables, math, frontmatter, embedded GMC diagrams, recursive code/Markdown embeds, paste-as-Markdown, HTML/PDF/PNG/DOCX export, plus Slides Studio: PowerPoint as code (.deck) with a PowerPoint-like visual editor, corporate templates, PowerPoint import, GitLab review and native .pptx export.
s009.gmc.open.graph.preview.to: GMC: Open Graph Preview to the Side
s011.gmc.export.markdown.diagram.as: GMC: Export Markdown Diagram as PNG
s012.gmc.export.all.markdown.diagrams: GMC: Export All Markdown Diagrams as PNG
s044.save.the.file.automatically.shortly: Save the file automatically shortly after every change made in the rich editor (independent of `#files.autoSave#`).
s048.bullet.character.for.unordered.list: Bullet character for unordered lists when serializing back to markdown.
Horizontal-rule character. Rendered as three of whichever you pick.
s063.keybinding.that.opens.the.selection: Keybinding that opens the selection bubble menu. If the cursor is inside a word with no active selection, the shortcut expands the selection to the surrounding word first. Format: modifier+key chain separated by `+` (e.g. `Mod+/`, `Ctrl+Shift+B`). `Mod` resolves to `Meta` on macOS, `Ctrl` elsewhere. Empty string disables the shortcut.
s064.language.label.applied.to.unlabelle: Language label applied to unlabelled code blocks. Empty leaves them bare (\`\`\`); `text` / `plaintext` adds a default label.
s067.default.view.for.the.rich: Default view for the rich diff panel.
s070.layout.for.the.source.line: Layout for the source (line-level) diff toggle.
s071.remove.blank.lines.between.consecut: Remove blank lines between consecutive list items (tight lists).
s072.strip.redundant.escapes.that.remark: Strip redundant `\~`, `\*`, `\_`, `\[` escapes that remark-stringify adds defensively.
s075.rebuild.table.headers.when.rehype: Rebuild table headers when rehype-remark emits an empty header row.
s089.color.theme.for.the.rich: Color theme for the rich editor and rich diff. `default` follows your VS Code color theme. `github-*` use GitHub's own colors (from GitHub's Primer design system); `claude-*` match the Claude desktop app.
s090.path.to.a.css.file: Path to a CSS file applied on top of the theme (absolute, `~/...`, or relative to the first workspace folder). Reloads live on save. Empty disables it.
s091.maximum.width.of.the.centered: Maximum width of the centered text column in the rich editor, in pixels. Use the maximum for a full-width page.
s092.body.text.size.in.the: Body text size in the rich editor, in pixels. Headings scale with it.
s093.space.between.lines.of.text: Space between lines of text, as a multiple of the font size.
s094.font.family.for.body.text: Font family for body text in the rich editor (e.g. `Inter`, `Georgia, serif`). Empty keeps the theme font. Code keeps the editor's monospace font.
s095.add.a.heading.above.generated: Add a heading above generated tables of contents (`<!-- embed:toc -->`). Override per block with `heading="false"` or `heading="Custom title"`.
s096.light.theme.on.a.transparent: Light theme on a transparent page (default).
s097.the.rich.editor.s.current: The rich editor's current theme and background.
s098.colors.of.html.pdf.png: Colors of HTML / PDF / PNG exports made from the rich editor.
s099.folder.for.assets.gmc.files: Folder for assets — `.gmc` files created by a GMC block's **to file**, and images pasted or dropped into the rich editor: relative to the Markdown document (e.g. `diagrams`), `${workspaceFolder}/…`, or absolute. Empty: next to the document. Created if missing.
s100.text.of.the.heading.added: Text of the heading added above generated tables of contents.
s101.show.the.markdown.source.line: Show the markdown source line number of each block in the margin of the rich editor.
s102.indent.each.heading.and.its: Indent each heading and its content by its depth in the heading hierarchy in the rich editor. Display only — the markdown is unchanged.
s103.compact.rail.of.heading.marks: Compact rail of heading marks at the left edge; hover to see names, click to jump
s106.how.the.heading.outline.is: How the heading outline is shown in the rich editor.
s107.cell.content.at.the.top: Cell content at the top of the cell
s109.cell.content.at.the.bottom: Cell content at the bottom of the cell
s110.vertical.alignment.of.table.cell: Vertical alignment of table cell content in the rich editor. (Horizontal alignment is per column and saved in the markdown — use the table toolbar.)
s111.graph.model.studio.gmc.diagrams: Graph Model Studio: GMC Diagrams & Markdown Toolkit
s112.automatically.open.the.graph.previe: Automatically open the graph preview when a GMC file becomes active.
s116.re.render.changed.gmc.image: Re-render changed `.gmc` image embeds when a Markdown or source file is saved. Rendering needs the graph panel, which then opens beside the editor. When off, changed diagrams are flagged stale and re-render on **Update Code Embeds** / **Update All Embeds in Workspace** (or the rich editor refresh).
s117.automatically.update.embeds.in.mark: Automatically update embeds in Markdown files when a referenced source file is saved.
s118.automatically.collapse.generated.co: Automatically collapse generated content between embed directives and their end markers.
s119.enable.automatic.conversion.of.rich: Enable automatic conversion of rich text to Markdown when pasting.
s120.override.cmd.c.ctrl.c: Override `Cmd+C` / `Ctrl+C` in Markdown files to copy as rich HTML. The clipboard contains HTML and the original Markdown.
s121.optional.path.to.a.chromium: Optional path to a Chromium, Chrome, or Edge executable used for PDF and PNG export.
s122.viewport.width.used.for.markdown: Viewport width used for Markdown preview PNG export.
s123.maximum.captured.page.height.used: Maximum captured page height used for Markdown preview PNG export.
s124.optional.path.to.the.pandoc: Optional path to the Pandoc executable used for DOCX export.
s125.optional.default.reference.docx.tem: Optional default reference DOCX template offered during Pandoc export.
s127.render.reference.thumbnails.with.po: Render reference thumbnails with PowerPoint during import (Windows, if installed).
s128.export.folder.relative.to.the: Export folder, relative to the source file.
s129.merge.request.target.branch.for: Merge request target branch for the “MR base” comparison (empty: origin's default branch).

s200.deck.thumbnail: Write <deck>.png (first slide) next to the deck when it is saved; Markdown Studio deck blocks show it.
s201.deck.foldFrontmatter: Fold the YAML headers (deck and slides) when a .deck source opens in the text editor, so the slide text reads first.
s204.pandoc.is.no.longer.used: Pandoc is no longer used: DOCX export is built in.
s205.reference.docs.are.replaced.by.mast: Reference documents are replaced by Markdown Studio masters: use "Import Word template as master".
s207.permissive.export: Write the document; unrepresentable content uses documented fallbacks listed in the report.
s208.strict.export: Refuse to write a document that would lose content.
s209.docx.export.mode: How **Export editable DOCX** handles content Word cannot represent.
s210.hidden.objects.in.docx: Whether objects hidden in the document are written to DOCX.
